fit_reason: Although the listing is tagged as a private seller, the photos and text show this is dealer stock from Bacon's Motors: the dealer banner and phone number are on the photos, the truck sits on the lot under the dealer sign, and the description ends with the dealership's name and address.
findings: Gray, weathered look on the black bug deflector across the front of the hood
Grime and dull finish on the chrome front bumper
Dull, faded black plastic on the rear bumper step and the tailgate handle area
Light haze on the headlight lenses
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2008 Sierra 2500. The white paint looks good, but the black bug deflector and rear bumper trim have faded, and the headlights show some haze. We do mobile pre-sale details with trim and headlight restoration and can come to your lot. Would you like a quote?
